question: Which deities should be installed in the middle of the ritual pavilion?
premises: The installation takes place in the middle.
The lord of gods of gods is the principal deity.
Brahmā and Viṣṇu accompany the principal deity.
inference: In the middle one should install the lord of gods of gods accompanied by Brahmā and Viṣṇu.
plain_english: In the middle, one should install the lord of gods of gods, accompanied by Brahmā and Viṣṇu.
